item.title: Spl visa rules ahead of Feb polls issued
item.description: The government has issued a set of special visa instructions ahead of the national election to ensure the safe and orderly arrival, stay and departure of foreign nationals.According to the order, existing visa policies must be strictly followed when issuing all types of visas, including visas on arrival. item.title: Voting privacy threatened as expatriates share ballots online
item.description: Images of completed postal ballots shared by Bangladeshi expatriates on social media are raising serious concerns among election authorities and civil society groups ahead of the 13th National Parliamentary Election and national referendum on February 12. item.title: More than 500 million request WC tickets: FIFA
item.description: Football's global governing body FIFA said Wednesday it had received more than 500 million requests for tickets to this year's World Cup despite rumbling controversy over sky-high prices to attend the event.FIFA said in a statement it had received applications from fans in all of its 211 member nations and territories for the tournament staged in the United States, Canada and Mexico.The window for submitting requests to be entered in a lottery which will allocate tickets closed on Tuesday. item.title: Govt borrowing jumps 619pc, raising private credit strain in Bangladesh
item.description: Bangladesh's private sector risks a tightening credit environment as government borrowing from the banking system has surged to nearly Tk 60,000 crore in the first half of the current fiscal year, raising concerns about reduced lending capacity for businesses.According to Bangladesh Bank data, the government's net borrowing from banks reached Tk 59,756 crore between July 1 and January 4 of FY2025-26.The amount accounts for more than 57 percent of the full-year borrowing target of Tk 1.04 lakh cr
